title: Make Repo CLI and MCP Work End to End
description: Get the repo CLI and MCP tools working end to end across supported clients. Reproduce and fix the Cursor MCP server loading failure, make configuration and bootstrapping zero-touch and cross-platform, and verify CLI, MCP resources, and MCP tools through real client-facing stdio flows.
summary: Repaired the repo CLI and MCP end to end by routing every IDE through the cross-platform Bun bootstrap, correcting canonical client and hook paths, fixing MCP server lifetime and close-path performance, restoring emoji-dated ticket discovery, and validating builds, CLI queries, MCP tools, resources, prompts, and client-specific handshakes.
